figs.name: star-vs-delta-connection-selection-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart to choose star or delta connection for distribution, motor starting or resilience
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog guiding the choice: star when a neutral and dual voltage are needed, star then delta for motor starting, delta for resilience and harmonics.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart for choosing star or delta connection</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Star or Delta? A Quick Decision Path</text>
<polygon points="400,64.0 580.0,112 400,160.0 220.0,112" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="107.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Need a neutral and both</text>
<text x="400" y="129.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">phase and line voltage?</text>
<line x1="220" y1="112" x2="180" y2="112" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="200" y="98" font-size="17" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="14" y="72" width="166" height="80" rx="10" fill="#16a34a" stroke="#14532d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="97.0" y="106.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Star</text>
<text x="97.0" y="130.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">230 V and 400 V</text>
<line x1="400" y1="160" x2="400" y2="190" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="420" y="180" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<polygon points="400,192.0 580.0,240 400,288.0 220.0,240" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="235.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Motor needs lower</text>
<text x="400" y="257.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">starting current?</text>
<line x1="220" y1="240" x2="180" y2="240" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="200" y="226" font-size="17" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="14" y="196" width="166" height="88" rx="10" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="97.0" y="222.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Start in star,</text>
<text x="97.0" y="245.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">run in delta</text>
<text x="97.0" y="268.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">58 % voltage</text>
<line x1="400" y1="288" x2="400" y2="318" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="420" y="308" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<polygon points="400,320.0 580.0,368 400,416.0 220.0,368" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#9333ea" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="363.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Ride through a winding</text>
<text x="400" y="385.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">fault or trap harmonics?</text>
<line x1="580" y1="368" x2="622" y2="368" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="601" y="354" font-size="17" fill="#581c87" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="622" y="328" width="160" height="80" rx="10" fill="#9333ea" stroke="#581c87" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="702.0" y="362.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Delta</text>
<text x="702.0" y="386.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">3 wire</text>
<line x1="400" y1="416" x2="400" y2="446" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="420" y="436" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<rect x="220" y="446" width="360" height="64" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="472.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Check machine nameplate</text>
<text x="400.0" y="496.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">and supply system</text>
<text x="400" y="540" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">A delta system can still deliver about two thirds capacity on two windings</text>
</svg>

figs.name: star-vs-delta-connection-phasor-infographic
figs.alt: phasor diagram showing star line voltage is root 3 times phase voltage
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog drawing the star phasors 120 degrees apart, the 230 V to 398.4 V worked example and the 58 percent winding voltage in star delta starting.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 540" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Phasor diagram showing why star line voltage is root 3 times phase voltage</title>
<rect width="800" height="540" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Why V_Line = √3 × V_Phase in Star</text>
<line x1="230" y1="300" x2="230.0" y2="150.0" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="3.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="230.0" y="138.0" font-size="18" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">V1</text>
<line x1="230" y1="300" x2="359.9038105676658" y2="375.0" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="3.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="389.9038105676658" y="399.0" font-size="18" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">V2</text>
<line x1="230" y1="300" x2="100.0961894323342" y2="375.0" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="3.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="70.0961894323342" y="399.0" font-size="18" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">V3</text>
<line x1="359.9038105676658" y1="375.0" x2="230.0" y2="150.0" stroke="#9333ea" stroke-width="3.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="336.9519052838329" y="256.5" font-size="18" fill="#581c87" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">V12</text>
<path d="M230.0 266.0 A34 34 0 0 0 200.6 317.0" fill="none" stroke="#4b5563" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="186" y="278" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">120°</text>
<rect x="430" y="80" width="340" height="200" rx="14" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="600" y="116" font-size="19" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Worked example, star</text>
<text x="600" y="156" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">V_Phase = 230 V</text>
<text x="600" y="192" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">V_Line = √3 × 230</text>
<text x="600" y="230" font-size="22" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">= 398.4 V ≈ 400 V</text>
<text x="600" y="262" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">two phasors 120° apart</text>
<rect x="430" y="300" width="340" height="190" rx="14" fill="#faf5ff" stroke="#9333ea" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="600" y="336" font-size="19" fill="#581c87" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Star delta starting</text>
<text x="600" y="376" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Each winding in star sees</text>
<text x="600" y="408" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">1 ÷ √3 of delta voltage</text>
<text x="600" y="446" font-size="24" fill="#581c87" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">≈ 58 %</text>
<text x="230" y="500" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">V12 is the vector difference of V1 and V2</text>
</svg>
